title: Learned intermediate Horn proof state under causal subgoal interchange

ownership.head: feat/activation-funnel-af04-proof-state
ownership.parent_scientific_result: AF-03 width-2 causal advantage failed; single width-1 seed exploratory
ownership.frozen_parent_model: original TypedLoop class hash-verified by AF-02 at 94bb2be; AF-03/02 unchanged

question: Does training addressed interchange on hidden derived intermediate proof states improve causal generalization beyond compute-matched task-plus-intermediate-status supervision?

source_truth.oracle: Finite Horn least-fixed-point closure from explicit facts and declared rules
source_truth.independent_check: Boolean truth table for AND/OR two-leaf branches, plus Lean4 decide on fully expanded generated rule expressions
source_truth.input_exclusion: Model receives only public initial-fact bits, graph incidence, node-role tags, rule arity, rule stage and bias. No derived statuses, applicability, proof trace, winning branch or ground-truth labels enter the encoder.
source_truth.proof_claim_limit: Lean certifies synthetic Boolean-Horn graph outcomes. Does not certify model predictions, original theorems, or general Lean proof search.

branch_templates: A->Q and B->Q in one conjunction rule
A->Q or B->Q in alternative Horn rules
data.held_composition: two OR subproofs with final AND gate, permutation4
data.held_depth: all proof compositions at depth3 with unseen permutation6
data.donor_restrictions: Identical graph, gate and untouched-subproof leaf facts; donor selected to change inferred selected subgoal, nearest in leaf-fact Hamming distance with deterministic tie-breaking
data.counterfactual_oracle: Replace one inferred Q_j value in recipient by donor Q_j truth; recompute final G using downstream Horn rules; retain recipient other Q
data.split_binding: Canonical feature-array SHA256 sets disjoint, corpus_manifest.json committed before training; any mismatch is fatal

model.source: Exact pinned original TypedLoop cell in experiments/lean_reasoner/train.py imported by AF-02
model.architecture: 11 atom nodes,10 rule nodes; width16; atom/rule separate affine input embeddings; type-shared tanh affine codec on every recurrent call; readout from role-selected Q0,Q1,G atoms
model.two_phase_graph: Stage 1 exposes only upstream proof DAG incidence. At its boundary, the model has an inferred hidden Q0/Q1. Stage 2 exposes only downstream Q0/Q1->G gate and does not re-inject upstream facts.
model.writer_and_cell_trainability: All model and codec parameters trainable from fresh identical per-seed/width random initial state across arms

training.per_seed_initialization: All arms identical initial tensors and independent same sampler RNG seed
training.shared_compute: Each arm computes one clean full rollout plus recipient/donor stage1 prefixes and a resumed stage2 suffix. Status arm trains a negative-control patch on the unaffected other subgoal. Causal arm trains an addressed Q patch; task arm trains a self patch. Architecture, step count, sampled cases, and number of native cell calls per optimization step are identical.

losses.task: clean goal CE +0.75 self-patch goal CE
losses.status: clean goal CE +0.5 pre-subgoal CE+0.25 post-subgoal CE +0.75 other-subgoal-patch goal CE +0.3 other-patch subgoal CE, original truth
losses.causal: clean goal CE +0.5 pre-subgoal CE+0.25 post-subgoal CE +0.75 addressed Q-patch counterfactual goal CE +0.3 addressed-patch counterfactual subgoal CE

training.fixed_checkpoint: Exactly final step, no early stopping or reruns based on heldout
training.access: Only train and dev permitted during training. Dev used for eligibility only. Preserve all three arms, every seed and width, negative results, raw logits and source/hash manifests.

metrics: whole-source code patch/direct donor exact logits
heldout.gate_eligibility: Within each width and seed, both status and causal models must attain >=0.80 goal accuracy and >=0.80 exact Q0/Q1 accuracy on train AND dev.
heldout.primary_hypothesis: For every eligible width2 seed, causal minus status informative-goal-flip addressed patch accuracy >=0.05 on BOTH held_composition and held_depth; causal clean goal >= status -0.03; causal untouched-Q correctness >=0.90; other patch goal retention >=0.90; causal false-positive goal attempts <= status in each. Aggregate fail on any eligible failure; pass if all seeds eligible and pass; otherwise inconclusive.
heldout.diagnostics: Report all seed/width families and unqualified comparisons without elevating them to registered positives.
heldout.label_verification: Recompute graph rules and exact recipient/donor oracle for every retained prediction, compare logits against recorded score and direct donor output; hash every retained artifact

certification.synth_case_theorems: one closed Boolean equality theorem for Q0,Q1,G in each case, computed by expanding actual declared Horn graph; by decide
certification.negative_case_handling: Explicit equalities to false are certified by Boolean decision procedure; no theorem-proof success claim for neural outputs

failure_policy: Engineering tests and numerical receipts must pass for CI green, independent of scientific hypothesis verdict. Persist every failing eligible stratum; scientific changes require AF-05 preregistration.
